journey.name: scan onchain no amount to amount
journey.description:
Verifies that pasting or scanning an on-chain BIP21 request without an amount still opens the Send amount screen, so the user can choose the amount before Confirm.
Precondition: onboarded dev wallet on regtest with confirmed Savings funds, a running synced node, and a regtest address the wallet does not own. Start on the wallet home screen.
iOS: the simulator has no camera, so set the clipboard with xcrun simctl pbcopy <device> and use Paste Invoice inside Send.

actions.action: Copy "bitcoin:<test recipient address>" to the simulator clipboard
Tap the Send button (id "Send"), and if a camera permission dialog appears, choose "Don't Allow"
Verify the Send amount screen (id "SendAmount") is visible and the Confirm screen (id "SendConfirm") is not
Tap "1" (id "N1") and "0" (id "N0") four times, then tap Continue (id "ContinueAmount")
Verify the Confirm screen (id "SendConfirm") is visible and the review amount (id "ReviewAmount-primary") shows 10 000
